name: Algorithms for Computational Biology
summary: The algorithms and probabilistic models behind bioinformatics tools: dynamic programming, indexing, assembly graphs and HMMs.

topics.name: Dynamic programming for alignment and its variants
Exact string matching: suffix trees, suffix arrays and the Burrows-Wheeler transform
Genome assembly: overlap graphs and de Bruijn graphs
Hidden Markov models: Viterbi, forward-backward and Baum-Welch
Phylogenetic algorithms: Felsenstein's pruning and tree search
Clustering and dimensionality reduction for expression data
Motif finding: Gibbs sampling and expectation-maximisation
Network inference and graph algorithms in biology
